// diagnostic

E0324

Type alias without type parameters — use `struct` for a distinct primitive name

What

Type alias without type parameters — use `struct` for a distinct primitive name

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use `struct` for a distinct primitive name, or add type parameters to the alias.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0324: tests/ui/type_alias_no_params.stderr.

Error [jet.AliasWithoutParameters]: A type alias needs type parameters — write `Name<T> :: …`
  --> tests/ui/type_alias_no_params.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | Meters :: Float
    | ^^^^^^
 Why: A transparent type alias is only for shortening generic spellings
 Fix: For a distinct type name over a primitive, use `struct Name(BaseType)` instead
